build._doc: Wrap every *.json in src/data/ as a globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[<key>] companion (data-*.json.js). Engine: front-data-json-js-wrapper.sh.

Generates every real independent page from the data manifests under src/data/ (shell.json + sections-core.json + sections-content.json + mock-apps.json — split by domain, see generate-pages.mjs). Runs after sass/esbuild so generated pages can reference the real style.css/script.js paths; the shell template registers the service worker itself (see main.ts) rather than relying on the sw_register injector, since that mod only targets a fixed file list and this project has dozens of generated pages at varying depths. 'manifest' here just anchors the data directory — generate-pages.mjs reads all 4 files from dirname(manifest).
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
